criteria: All 59 downstream processing, ontology, visitor presentation and release tasks have documented review evidence.
The 482-part scene and 43-type shared architectural ontology use stable machine-readable identifiers.
Architectural facts and dimensional aggregates have traceable public sources and limitations.
Scene navigation, browser rendering, component picking, relationship links, cutaway and lighting have automated desktop/mobile QA.
The model uses original procedural geometry; no museum photographs, surveyed scans, figural sculpture or proprietary assets are redistributed.
The website prominently identifies omitted historical art, interpretive site geometry and unverified model details.
qualityLimit: The output is an educational, interpretive 3D reconstruction and NOT an archaeological measured model, conservation document, complete historical interior, surveyed geospatial asset, or complete sculptural reproduction.
futureImprovements: Measured specialist drawings and georeferenced surveys
Archaeologically defensible surface pigments and carved detail with redistribution rights
